scope: Direct visual transcription of every exterior color table or complete named paint list printed for the 1996, 1999, 2000, 2006, and 2007 Chevrolet Express in the retained official General Motors vehicle information kits, plus explicit retained source gaps for 2001 through 2003. Passenger, Cargo, Commercial Cutaway, RV Cutaway, YF2 Ambulance, YF7 Upfitter, Mobility/Paratransit, regular ZY1, SEO solid paint, and other simultaneous programs remain separate. No color, code, restriction, or availability is projected across a variant or model year.

method.render_scale: Every page was reviewed in contact sheets; cited chart pages were rendered at 4x for 1996, 1999, and 2000 and at 2x or higher for 2006 and 2007.
method.source_integrity: Each retained PDF matched the SHA-256 and byte count in the GM Heritage artifact ledger.
method.code_policy: source_color_code preserves the chart's Color Code 1, Color Code, or literal none value. rpo_code repeats a printed regular paint code. seo_code repeats a printed SEO option code. No WA number is supplied unless the reviewed year and chart printed it.
method.absence_policy: A program marked not located documents only that no separate chart for that program was found in the complete reviewed kit. It does not prove that the program was unavailable through every ordering channel.
method.gap_policy: No 2001, 2002, or 2003 Express kit appears in the retained official Chevrolet kit index or the 691 source artifact corpus. The available Astro kits for those years are different models and were not used as substitutes. Adjacent Express years were not used to infer a palette.
method.archive_manifest_review: The three retained source release manifests were searched by SHA-256. None of the five reviewed PDFs was listed, so each source retains a null archive URL and an explicit not listed status.
